title: Fraud Rule Worst Case
brief: Our fraud screening service evaluates each transaction against a decision tree of rules stored as TreeNode objects: at each rule the transaction goes to the left or right child, and it stops at a rule with no children. To size our latency budget, we need to know the most rules a single transaction could ever pass through.
Implement longestRuleChain(root), where root is the top rule of the tree, and return the number of rules on the longest path from the root down to a rule with no children.
